author: Axiom I
title: Adaptive Lossy Links Ring v0.1: Rate control under loss
abstract: Adaptive controller for lossy uni/bidir rings. Maps p_send to AdaptiveSampler.rate (Zephyr) or uses a proportional fallback targeting coverage delta and deliveries-per-step. Runs replicates for uni/bidir at reliability=0.8 and saves aggregated metrics.
